cases.question: Summarize this page
cases.rawText: **AI Career Operating System** is a governed AI workflow that turns vetted career evidence into recruiter‑ready artifacts. Daniel defined the product architecture, evidence boundaries, evaluation criteria, and human‑review workflow, and integrated the Portfolio Guide with the ResumeCustomizer via authenticated server‑to‑server APIs. The system includes source‑audited retrieval, bounded claim limits, six advisory reviewers, and structural PDF checks, with a documented reduction in static asset size from 147 MiB to 81 MiB. This work demonstrates a complete, end‑to‑end proof‑engine for AI‑generated career materials, though full production deployment and real‑world adoption are future milestones.
